arxiv-2105-09802.title: On time-parallel preconditioning for the state formulation of incremental weak constraint 4D-Var
arxiv-2105-09802.creator: Ieva Daužickaitė*, Amos S. Lawless, Jennifer A. Scott, Peter Jan van Leeuwen
arxiv-2105-09802.description: Abstract Using a high degree of parallelism is essential to perform data assimilation efficiently. The state formulation of the incremental weak constraint four-dimensional variational data assimilation method allows parallel calculations in the time dimension. In this approach, the solution is approximated by minimising a series of quadratic cost functions using the conjugate gradient method.

arxiv-2208-13865.title: Minimum Color Spanning Circle of Imprecise Points Thanks: A preliminary version of this paper appeared in the Proceedings of the 27th International Conference on Computing and Combinatorics (COCOON 2021).
arxiv-2208-13865.creator: Ankush Acharyya, Ramesh K. Jallu, Vahideh Keikha, Maarten Löffler, Maria Saumell
arxiv-2208-13865.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Ankush Acharyya, Ramesh K. Jallu, Vahideh Keikha, Maarten Löffler, Maria Saumell. Let ℛ \cal R be a set of n n colored imprecise points, where each point is colored by one of k k colors. Each imprecise point is specified by a unit disk in which the point lies. We study the problem of computing the smallest and the largest possible minimum color spanning circle, among all possible choices of points inside their corresponding disks.

arxiv-2212-09140.title: Unsupervised Discontinuous Constituency Parsing with Mildly Context-Sensitive Grammars
arxiv-2212-09140.creator: Songlin Yang, Roger P. Levy, Yoon Kim
arxiv-2212-09140.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Songlin Yang, Roger P. Levy, Yoon Kim. We study grammar induction with mildly context-sensitive grammars for unsupervised discontinuous parsing. Using the probabilistic linear context-free rewriting system (LCFRS) formalism, our approach fixes the rule structure in advance and focuses on parameter learning with maximum likelihood.

arxiv-2505-05420.title: Robustly optimal dynamics for active matter reservoir computing
arxiv-2505-05420.creator: Mario U. Gaimann, Miriam Klopotek
arxiv-2505-05420.description: Abstract Information processing abilities of active matter are studied in the reservoir computing (RC) paradigm to infer the future state of a chaotic signal. We uncover an exceptional regime of agent dynamics that has been overlooked previously. It appears robustly optimal for performance under many conditions, thus providing valuable insights into collective and physical computation more generally.

pmc-10741573.title: The Defined TLR3 Agonist, Nexavant, Exhibits Anti-Cancer Efficacy and Potentiates Anti-PD-1 Antibody Therapy by Enhancing Immune Cell Infiltration
pmc-10741573.creator: Seung-Hwan Lee, Young-Ho Choi, Soon Myung Kang, Min-Gyu Lee, Arnaud Debin, Eric Perouzel, Seung-Beom Hong, Dong-Ho Kim
pmc-10741573.description: Simple SummaryNexavant, a newly reported TLR3 agonist, has advantages over Poly(I:C) in terms of quality control and pre-clinical efficacy. Here, we further investigated the physicochemical properties, downstream signaling pathways, anti-cancer efficacy, and mechanism of action of Nexavant. The Nexavant was homogenous in solution and less sensitive to RNase A, and showed thermostability compared with Poly(I:C).

pmc-11521006.description: This retrospective study aimed to evaluate the visual outcomes and foveal restoration in eyes with rhegmatogenous retinal detachment (RRD) and macular hole (MH) following surgery using the inverted internal limiting membrane (ILM) flap technique.We collected data on eyes with coexisting RRD and MH that underwent surgery using the inverted ILM flap technique between January 2016 and December 2018.

pmc-13376402.title: ZIF-8 membrane-based cryo-stripping of trace impurities towards electronic grade C3H6 production
pmc-13376402.creator: Kunpeng Yu, Yachao Dong, Taotao Ji, Jiaxu Liu, Shiya Gu, Jianzhong Yin, Xinyu He, Bin Zheng, Jiachen Wang, Yunlei Gao, Guillaume Maurin, Yi Liu
pmc-13376402.description: Electronic-grade (EG) C3H6 represents an essential feedstock for semiconductor manufacturing, yet its purification remains energy-intensive due to the difficulty in removing trace C3H8 impurities via conventional cryogenic distillation, which requires high pressure and low temperature operation conditions. In this study, we demonstrate efficient C3H6/C3H8 separation under practical operation conditions using a ZIF-8 membrane prepared at near-freezing temperature.

pmc-13431297.title: Nail gun penetrating cervical spine injury at C4–5 with spinal canal violation, neurological deficit, and esophageal perforation treated by anterior cervical surgery: illustrative case
pmc-13431297.creator: Chengfei Peng, Zhizhu Peng
pmc-13431297.description: BACKGROUNDPenetrating cervical spine injuries caused by nail guns are rare. Imaging showed that the nail traversed the C4–5 disc space, entered the vertebral body, and violated the spinal canal.

pmc-13482992.creator: Haoyu Wang, Ziyan Zhang, Haipeng Gong
pmc-13482992.description: An informative molecular representation is prerequisite for the accurate prediction of molecular property by machine learning, but demands large-scale data enriched with detailed physicochemical information for its effective learning. uslaw-usc-t5-s5404.title: 5 U.S.C. § 5404 — Human capital performance payments
uslaw-usc-t5-s5404.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t5-s5404.description: United States Code, Title 5 (Government Organization And Employees); Part III (Employees); Subpart D (Pay And Allowances); Chapter 54 (Human Capital Performance Fund). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) (1) Notwithstanding any other provision of law, the Office may authorize an agency to provide human capital performance payments to individual employees based on exceptional performance contributing to the achievement of the agency.
